description: Derived comparison of ESR contracted export sales against GATS actual shipments for one commodity: total contracted, total shipped, and the gap in metric tons — a positive gap means sold but not yet shipped. Use to gauge the unshipped export backlog; use get_export_sales or get_trade_flows instead for the underlying weekly or monthly detail. Read-only; no API key. This is a computed aggregate across both stored datasets over all stored periods, not a USDA-published figure; totals are rounded to whole tons.

partner.description: Partner country code (2-letter ISO/GENC, e.g. MX, CN) or omit for all partners

name: compare_contracts_vs_shipments
